refusals.scope: Named raw outputs and exact permission/byte captures plus normal exit through authenticated source assertions. Error enum values and each intermediate in-memory byte verification are source assertions, not separately serialized objects.

comparators.registers: 25 non-RIP/non-RFLAGS register words exact; declared logical/physical RIP; only original TF bit8 and RF bit16 excluded from RFLAGS; complete canonical XSAVE2287/application4096/stack4232 exact.

limitations: Only the six explicitly listed commands and four fixed native modes are reported. Broader validation is separate, with no inherited or inferred pass/not-run status.
Private source snapshots retain null tested revisions; matching base commits are reconstruction identities only.
Selected tool/runtime owners are a bounded observation set, not complete loader closure or continuous attestation.
192 comparisons and 36 CALL witnesses are repeated fixed executions, not a unique architecture-coverage denominator.
Report/controller objects, exact in-memory error enums and some immutable-range reads are authenticated executed source assertions, not additional separately serialized captures.
The direct gate clock access and this native result do not establish a software preemption clock, arbitrary subject/foreign caller/signal support, full A5 or complete claims 1–4.
The existing unsafe attachment excludes signals, recursive writers and foreign unwind. Generated owners remain retained; reclamation is not established.

lineage.historical_scope: All earlier failed or held sources and zero-helper stops remain separate; these six actual gate-clock executions grant them no new outcome.

original_subject.scope: Retained exact separately built subject; original producer/byte provenance remains historical. No new gate-clock assemble/link receipt is claimed.

report_scope.broader_validation: Clippy, ordinary library/unit/oracle compilation, models, calibrations, docs, MSRV, fallback, preparer qualification and public workspace gates are recorded separately. This scoped report asserts neither their status nor their absence.
report_scope.case_row_scope: Four aggregate native-mode rows and eight nested refusal/permission-control rows; they are not twelve separate native cohorts.
report_scope.qualification_complete_meaning: Full frontend/source qualification is outside this six-command record. All four original native modes are complete within the stated scope.

reproduction.scope: The unchanged request-only preparer and original bounded commands reconstruct fresh attempts. The immutable material records creation-time qualification status; later preparation and broader validation results are separate. Fresh source/tool/runtime/artifact admission remains required; no new executor.
reproduction.source_reconstruction: 510 exact selected base files plus 13 overlays recover the 523-file private source map. The historical evaluation README overlay belongs only in the private workcopy.
